entity.description:
Pallet Fly is an innovative platform that is geared towards streamlining and optimizing the supply chain experience in product distribution.

Our website was founded with one goal in mind: Bring innovation to supply chain. With the many evolving marketplaces that have sprouted through the internet, there comes a great change in how consumer products changes hands. From Amazon to Walmart, brick-and-mortar to Ecommerce, all consumer shopping has taken a large drift from what was knows as traditional retail several years ago. The evolution of how products are sourced on a wholesale level has taken far longer to progress.

We want to help you save time, increase profits, and save you countless hours of frustration.

Sourcing for Online Retailers:

Over the last few years we have all watched Amazon.com & other 3rd party marketplaces closely. entity.name: B2B Supply Hub
entity.description:
B2B Supply Hub: Your Strategic Partner for Importing in South Africa.

At B2B Supply Hub, we empower SA retailers, e-commerce businesses & niche distributors to thrive by providing seamless, hassle-free access to globally trending products. As a dedicated direct importer & wholesale supplier based in Cape Town, we specialise in delivering high-demand, e-commerce friendly goods directly to your warehouse with a manageable 1-pallet MOQ.

Solving Your Sourcing Challenges:
Many established businesses face significant hurdles in sourcing unique, profitable products, from navigating complex international logistics & customs to dealing with unreliable overseas suppliers and large, risky MOQs. B2B Supply Hub acts as your expert import department, eliminating these headaches.

Our Core Value Proposition:
Globally Trending Products: We meticulously research and vet the next big market trends, ensuring you gain a competitive edge with fresh, in-demand inventory. Our focus includes high-potential categories like electronics, home goods and lifestyle items.
Simplified, Risk-Free Importing: We handle the entire import process, from international supplier management and quality checks to customs clearance & local delivery within South Africa. You receive your stock ready to sell, reducing your operational burden and financial risk.
Optimised for Your Margins: By cutting out unnecessary middlemen, our direct import model offers competitive wholesale pricing, allowing you to secure stronger profit margins. Our 1-pallet MOQ balances bulk buying advantages with flexible inventory management.
Local Support & Quality Assurance: Benefit from local quality control upon arrival in SA, coupled with accessible South African-based customer support, including straightforward warranty & returns processes.
Who Benefits:
Ideal for mid-sized retailers in SA, growing Takealot or Shopify sellers & niche distributors looking to expand their product ranges. Partner with us to drive significant growth.
